purpose: First-party deterministic transition grammar. Transitions must carry focus, material, path, depth or state between beats; never exist only as spectacle.

transitions.name: Liquid Wipe
transitions.signature: soft organic edge crosses frame while preserving visual continuity

transitions.name: Refraction Pass
transitions.signature: translucent lens band passes across content and reveals next layer

transitions.name: Editorial Rule Carry
transitions.signature: one rule extends, becomes the next scene baseline and releases focus

transitions.name: Type Mask Handoff
transitions.signature: large type/block mask hands frame ownership to the next beat

transitions.name: Paper Plane Slide
transitions.signature: tactile plane passes foreground and exposes next layer beneath

transitions.name: Documentary Crop Match
transitions.signature: verified-media aperture changes crop while captions remain deterministic

transitions.name: Cinematic Matte Gate
transitions.signature: controlled top/bottom matte closes then opens into the next verified/conceptual frame

transitions.name: Depth Plane Pass
transitions.signature: foreground plane occludes frame while camera-space relationship carries forward

transitions.name: Technical Scan Line
transitions.signature: scan plane validates/reveals state from one side to the other

transitions.name: Mosaic Reflow
transitions.signature: asymmetric cells reorganize hierarchy and expose the next beat

transitions.name: Data Orbit Carry
transitions.signature: focus marker travels along an orbital/system path into the next metric

transitions.name: Quiet Hold Fade
transitions.signature: long controlled opacity/space handoff with one persistent anchor

rules: A transition must explain continuity, focus, state, depth, material or hierarchy.
Do not use more unique transition grammars than the story needs; coherence beats novelty.
No bounce, spring or elastic motion for Agua Bienestar.
Official logos and waves are never distorted to create a transition.
Factual text must remain readable and deterministic before/after the transition.
A generative transition is optional; deterministic first-party transitions remain the default.
